name: Pronghorn
label: Pronghorn
about_prose: Pronghorn is a 640-acre master-planned resort community on Central Oregon's high desert, northeast of Bend off Powell Butte Highway. The property is surrounded by 20,000 acres of federally protected BLM land and sits within a juniper forest with views of Mt. Bachelor and the Three Sisters. The residential side includes four neighborhoods: Four Peaks, Estates, Residences, and Villas.

Two 18-hole championship golf courses anchor the community. The Jack Nicklaus Signature Course opened in 2004 as the only Jack Nicklaus course in Oregon. The Tom Fazio Championship Course opened in 2007 and is reserved for members and their guests. Pronghorn is one of only two clubs in the United States with both a Nicklaus and a Fazio course on the same property.

The resort operation rebranded from Pronghorn Resort to Juniper Preserve in October 2022 under The Resort Group, shifting toward wellness and hospitality. The 104-room Juniper Lodge opened in April 2019. Lodging, dining, spa, and golf run under the Juniper Preserve name, while the residential club continues as Pronghorn Club.

amenities.name: Jack Nicklaus Signature Course
amenities.description: Par-72 course playing 7,379 yards from the tips, opened in 2004. Plays firm and fast across ancient lava ridges with Cascade views.

amenities.name: Tom Fazio Championship Course
amenities.description: Par-72 course playing 7,456 yards from the tips, opened in 2007. Rolling fairways and a signature par-3 eighth hole over a 45-foot canyon with an exposed lava tube.

amenities.name: Pronghorn Golf Academy
amenities.description: On-site instruction facility with a Sportsbox AI 3D swing-analysis studio and True Spec club fitting.

amenities.name: Juniper Spa
amenities.description: Full-service spa with treatments drawing on Central Oregon's landscape, plus an on-property lava cave used for guided meditation and sound baths.

amenities.name: The Trailhead
amenities.description: Outdoor recreation hub with heated pools, hot tubs, and fitness facilities.

amenities.name: Coyote Lounge and Trailhead Grill
amenities.description: Bar and lounge at the clubhouse plus casual dining at the recreation hub and on-course Grill On The Green.

amenities.name: Juniper Lodge
amenities.description: 104-room boutique hotel with private terraces and panoramic views, opened April 2019.

amenities.name: Spirit Island Event Venue
amenities.description: 7,000-square-foot private island venue for weddings and events, capacity up to 300.
